title: Hungarian Hospitality: Shoes, Gifts, and Generosity

sections.content:
Key Hungarian home-visiting customs:
- **Cipőlevétel** (Taking off shoes): In Hungarian homes, shoes are almost universally taken off in the hallway (*előszoba*). Hosts usually offer guest slippers (*vendégpapucs*).
- **Bringing a gift**: It is customary never to arrive empty-handed (*üres kézzel*). Bring dessert, flowers, or a bottle of wine.
- **Refusing food once**: Hosts will insist you eat more: *Vegyél még egy kicsit!* (Have a little more!). It is polite to accept second helpings!

sections.title: Hospitality Expressions
rows: Make yourself at home with us!
Have some more of the cake!
Feel free to take off your shoes!

items.english: Here, here is a comfortable guest slipper.
